The $499 MacBook Neo didn't just give Apple a budget laptop — it exposed the MacBook Air as a product without a purpose. Sandwiched between the Neo's stunning build quality and repairability at half the price, and the M5 MacBook Pro's vastly superior display, speakers, battery, and active cooling for just $300 more, the M5 MacBook Air's $1,099 starting price is increasingly hard to justify.
